What you'll do - Advise global stakeholders on regulatory compliance matters. - Assess regulatory risks and provide practical, business-focused solutions. - Support product registrations and market access activities worldwide. - Interpret and translate legislation into clear guidance for the business. - Share regulatory knowledge and contribute to training initiatives. - Act as a subject matter expert within your area of expertise.
